draft_rule: Count reports, not individual incidents or victims.
Use one reviewed primary category per report.
Review keywords and descriptions before naming a crime category.
Document the primary-category rule; keep unresolved cases visible.
Use age 50+ inclusive as our working definition; verify victim context.
An older suspect or witness is not evidence of an elderly victim.
No age mention does not prove that a victim is young.
The team agrees definitions and model selection before labels are published.
